description: The fan-out workflow end to end: a planner splits one change across three independent packages, three children run in parallel in their own checkouts, and the synthesizer reports what they delivered. Pins the property that makes fan-out worth doing — the subtasks are file-disjoint, so no child's branch clobbers another's.
title: Give every metric type a String method
prompt: Every metric type in this repository renders itself the same way, but none of them can. Add a `String() string` method to `counter.Counter`, `gauge.Gauge` and `timer.Timer` following the rendering format in CLAUDE.md, each with a test in its own package. The three packages are independent and nothing imports anything else.
